settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Personalize your tab workspace
settings.resetConfirm: Reset all settings to defaults? Continue?
settings.resetFailed: Failed to reset settings, please retry
settings.colorThemeHint: Accent palette and dark-mode surfaces follow the preset
settings.threshold: Site grouping threshold (tabs per domain to auto-group)
settings.thresholdHint: Group tabs of a domain once they reach this count; set to 1 to group every domain with any tab (single-tab sites included)
settings.tabOrderSyncHint: When on, drag tabs in the sidebar to reorder and sync to the browser's native tab order (native changes sync back too)
settings.shortcutDiscardInactive: Discard inactive tabs in this window
settings.shortcutPanelSearch: Focus the search box inside the panel
settings.shortcutPalette: Open the command palette inside the panel
settings.shortcutLocatePanel: Locate the active tab inside the panel
settings.shortcutCustomizeHint: Change keys in the browser's extension shortcut settings
settings.exportDataHint: Exports collections, pinned shortcuts, collapsed groups, settings, and all snapshots/archives; open tabs and undo records are not included
settings.importDataHint: Validates the JSON locally, then replaces the exported data without changing open tabs; any failed partition rolls the whole import back
settings.importBookmarksHint: Imports top-level bookmark-bar folders as collections (merged by name, URLs deduped)
settings.syncMirrorHint: Off by default. When on, your collections and settings are mirrored to your browser account's sync channel (Tabs has no server of its own). Turning it off deletes the data already uploaded
settings.clearDataHint: Delete fixed folders, pinned items, all snapshots & archives, the undo stack and the cross-device sync mirror; settings are reset to defaults. This cannot be undone
settings.clearDataDesc: The following data will be permanently deleted:
settings.clearDataIrreversible: This cannot be undone. Export a backup first.
settings.clearDataAck: I understand the data above will be permanently deleted and cannot be recovered
settings.clearDataFailed: Failed to clear data, please retry
settings.exportFailed: Export failed: local data could not be read
settings.exportDiagnosticsHint: Save a local report of degraded operations (timestamps and error descriptions only, no page titles or URLs) to attach to a bug report
settings.diagnosticsEmpty: No issues recorded in this session
settings.saveFailed: Setting not saved: storage unavailable, please retry
settings.importConfirm: Importing will replace current fixed data, settings, and snapshots. Continue?
settings.importFailed: Import failed: invalid or unreadable backup
settings.showPinnedStripHint: Show the always-on tiles area at the top of the sidebar (includes fixed-space tiles and native pinned tabs)
settings.sidePanelPositionHint: Chrome controls this position. Choose left or right in Chrome's side panel settings; Tabs follows it automatically
settings.footerLabelsHint: When on, icon buttons show a function name beside them for quick recognition (default: icons + hover tooltip only)
settings.showUrlHint: Show the full URL below the tab title
settings.showSplitBadgesHint: Show "Split / Companion" badges for tabs in browser split view
settings.autoScrollActiveHint: Scroll the current tab into the visible area when switching
settings.closeOnMiddleClickHint: Click a tab row with the middle mouse button to close it
settings.sortModeHint: "Most recent" settles newly opened pages once (newest on top); switching tabs never reshuffles the list
settings.pinnedStripSizeHint: Size of always-on tile icons (applies to both the fixed-space strip and native pinned tabs)
settings.groupAccentStyleHint: Site group accent: auto color by domain, or a uniform neutral
settings.newTabPositionHint: New tabs open at the end of the window, or right after the active tab — no matter how they are created (Ctrl+T, the browser + button, or the panel button)
settings.discardNotifyHint: Show a system notification when auto-discard runs (always undoable in panel)
settings.reuseNotifyHint: Show a notice when duplicate tabs are auto-merged
settings.badgeModeHint: Badge content: duplicate count when duplicates exist, otherwise tab count
settings.contextMenusHint: Quick actions on page / link / tab-bar / toolbar-icon right-click
settings.omniboxHint: Type th plus keywords to jump to tabs and fixed items
settings.noCacheHint: Matching sites get forced no-store response headers (subresources included, equivalent to DevTools "Disable cache"); matching tabs show a "No" badge in the side panel; enabling requires site access permission
settings.noCachePatternsHint: Domain / domain+path / full URL prefix — e.g. example.com
settings.noCachePatternPlaceholder:
One per line, e.g.:
example.com
example.com/app
https://example.com/app
settings.noCachePatternHelp: One per line; applies on blur or Save (⌘/Ctrl+Enter)
settings.noCachePermissionDenied: Site permission not granted — feature stays off
settings.noCachePermissionLost: Site permission lost — rules are inactive
settings.autoDiscardHint: Automatically freeze tabs that haven't been visited for a set period to free memory; auto-discards can be undone
settings.discardWhitelistHint: These domains never auto-discard (e.g. mail.example.com or example.com; fixed items are exempt by default)
settings.searchAllWindowsHint: When on, search covers tabs in other windows and switches to them in one step (default: current window only)
settings.autoGroupNativeHint: When on, tabs aggregated by site or language are automatically grouped into browser-native tab groups (except opener-tree mode); turning it off disbands the groups created by this feature
settings.autoGroupNativeDisableConfirm: Turning this off will disband native groups created by Tabs without closing tabs. Continue?
settings.actionClickHint: "Open side panel" keeps the default behavior; "Organize tabs" re-groups the temp area by site in the background without opening the panel (reopen it anytime via the side panel entry or Ctrl+Shift+O)
settings.undoStackLimitHint: Maximum consecutive close operations that can be undone (oldest records are evicted beyond this)
settings.toastDurationHint: How long status toasts (e.g. "Closed N tabs") stay visible
settings.rowActionsVisibleHint: When off, row actions (mute/pin/duplicate etc.) appear on hover or focus
settings.pinyinSearchHint: Match Chinese tab titles by pinyin initials or full pinyin (e.g. "tb" or "taobao" both hit "淘宝")
settings.persistUndoHint: When off, undo records last only for the current session
settings.uniqueUrlTabsHint: When opening a URL that already exists, switch to the most recently accessed tab; if multiple tabs share the URL, keep the most recent and close the rest. When off, duplicate URLs are allowed
settings.autoSaveSnapshotsHint: When on: ① snapshot on the interval below; ② snapshot when a window closes. Depends on browser background scheduling, so a perfectly fresh snapshot is not guaranteed — save important work manually
settings.autoSnapshotIntervalMinHint: Auto-save the current window this often; skipped when nothing changed
settings.maxAutoSnapshotsHint: Keep only the latest N auto snapshots (both interval and window-close); older ones are evicted beyond this

status.duplicateTitle: This URL has {{count}} duplicates in this window
status.noCacheTitle: This tab matches a "disable cache" rule

errors.dataLoadFailed: Failed to load data. Check extension permissions.
errors.storageDegraded: Some changes may not have been saved. Check storage space or extension permissions.
errors.boundaryBody: The interface hit an error it cannot recover from. Your data is still saved locally — retry or reload the panel.

onboarding.step1Body: Tabs in the current window are listed in the sidebar automatically — no setup needed to view and organize them.
onboarding.step2Title: Pin the pages you use often
onboarding.step2Body: Drag frequent pages to the always-on tiles for quick switching, or into Collections inside Fixed space for long-term keeping — one click to open.
onboarding.step3Title: Jump to any tab with a few keystrokes
onboarding.step3Body: Press ⌘K / Ctrl+K to focus search, type a title, URL, or pinyin initials, then ↑↓ to pick and Enter to switch.
onboarding.feature1: Context menus: right-click a page / link / tab bar to hibernate, pin, or search by site
onboarding.feature2: Address bar command: type th plus keywords to jump to tabs and pinned items
onboarding.feature3: Undo history: every close can be undone, so mis-closes are safe
onboarding.feature4: Toolbar badge: live duplicate count / total tabs

presets.title: Quick presets
presets.customDesc: Your current setup is manually tuned and doesn't match any preset; click a preset above to apply it in one go
presets.hint: Apply a profile that fits you; fine-tune individual options afterward
presets.researcherDesc: Organize by project: site grouping + recency sort + pinyin search
presets.saverDesc: Auto-hibernate idle tabs to free memory; pinned items exempt by default
presets.efficiencyDesc: Keyboard-first: always-on row actions, middle-click close, instant jump

palette.title: Command palette
palette.placeholder: Type a command or search tabs…

safety.shieldTitle: {{count}} undoable actions this session: every close can be undone

snapshots.title: Session snapshots
snapshots.empty: This snapshot has no tabs to restore
snapshots.emptyHint: No snapshots yet. Closed windows are auto-saved, or save the current window anytime.
snapshots.groupNamedDesc: Manually saved window, kept long-term, reopens tabs on restore (includes topic-grouped workspaces)
snapshots.groupArchiveDesc: Auto-saved when a window closes; original tabs are closed and fully restorable anytime
snapshots.groupAutoDesc: Safety-net snapshot when a window closes unexpectedly, auto-kept by the system
snapshots.crashGuidance: No undo records this session, but you have auto-saved snapshots — restore a whole window from them.
snapshots.saveSpaceHint: Save all tabs of the current window as a "workspace" snapshot you can restore anytime. Each save adds a new entry (nothing is overwritten) — view, rename or delete them in the list below
snapshots.importOneTabHint: Paste the text exported from OneTab; we parse the URLs and save them as one snapshot
snapshots.importUnparsed: No URL found: make sure you pasted OneTab export text (one http/https URL per line) and it is under 1MB
snapshots.reportHint: Local aggregation only — no network or account involved

tips.discoverTitle: Unlock all of Tabs in three steps
tips.discoverBody: ① Right-click a page / link / tab bar for one-tap hibernate, pin, or search-by-site; ② Type th + keyword in the address bar to jump straight to a tab or pinned item; ③ Press ⌘P (Ctrl+P) to open the command palette and hibernate / save snapshots / open settings in one go.

cap.contextMenuHow: Right-click a page, link, or tab bar to quickly hibernate / pin / search by site
cap.omniboxHow: Type th + keyword in the address bar to jump straight to a tab or pinned item
cap.paletteHow: Search and act directly: hibernate all, save snapshot, open settings
cap.pinHow: Drag go-to pages to the always-on tiles, or into Collections inside Fixed space — one tap to open
cap.snapshotHow: Windows are auto-saved on close, or save the current window manually anytime
cap.undoHow: Every close is undoable — no fear of misclosing
